steps.content: The passage is narrow, suffocating. She can't tell if anyone's chasing her; all she hears is the pounding of her own heartbeat.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Run... Run...
She gasps for air. Is it a lack of oxygen, or is the world twisting around her? Black ichor begins to ooze from the ceiling, walls, and floor, almost like blood.
She doesn't see Milly, but she can hear that familiar laugh. Soft and sweet, wrapped around a feverish edge.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Who... who's going to stop her?!
She clutches the communicator, sending one distress message after another. But there's no signal. Just a glaring exclamation mark next to each failed attempt.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Damn it!
Ignoring the terrifying sounds behind her, she sticks to Cassian's escape route, racing through corridor after corridor. At last, she reaches the fifth level and dashes out of the passage...

...to the surface of the WhiteSands? It dawns on her: most of the ship is buried beneath the sand, carefully concealed. How long have they been trapped here in this sunless tomb? Like they were already pronounced dead.

Sallie steels herself. No time for shock. The sandstorm howls outside. She searches the deck and finds the small boat Cassian hid behind a stack of wine barrels. She activates the crane, lowering the boat toward the sand, and jumps in when it's near the surface.
The key. Right, the key! She fumbles for it with trembling hands. As she goes to start the engine, she glances up to confirm her escape route.
But in that one glance, Sallie sees something that makes her freeze. That split second of distraction costs her everything.

steps.speaker: Puppet
steps.content: Chief
The underground puppet leaps onto the boat, pinning her down. The key slips from her grasp.
The key Cassian entrusted to her glints once before hitting the sand. In the blink of an eye, it vanishes into the quicksand, as if it had never existed at all.
The puppet grabs Sallie and hurls her back onto the cruise ship. A figure steps into view, and once again, she hears that sweet, terrifying voice.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Why the hesitation? You can't escape those things if you're that slow.
She gently pushes the puppet aside and straightens Sallie's clothes, like she's helping a friend.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly...
Before she can utter a plea, Sallie sees it—a metal chain caught on the tattered hem of Milly's dress. It's Cassian's, and it's stained with blood.
Sallie's mind goes blank.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What did you do to Cassian...?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Take a guess?
Such an offhand reply. Her smile is so harsh it hurts. Now, even fear feels insignificant.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Wasn't he your friend? We supported each other in this hellhole. Weren't we friends?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Supporting each other? No, we each had our own pillars. He wanted revenge, I wanted my love. Isn't that what you said? People can only find happiness by looking out for themselves.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's not the same! You're not like this!
Milly bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Then what am I like? Unschooled, brainwashed, naive, stupid. A girl who'd run after anyone who dangled love as the bait... You saw right through me, didn't you? What else did you expect? You barely even knew me, and you decided that I was a good person...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You can't even trust the one you love. Where did all that rational cynicism go?
She leans in closer, her eyes glowing with an uncanny light. Her power has grown stronger.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Why did you stop just now? What made you hesitate? You were so close to getting away... Did you see something? Oh, don't tell me...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You saw that other boat, didn't you?
Milly's eyes dart toward the boat that had distracted Sallie.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Looks expensive. No doubt a rich person's toy. But what does that have to do with you? Let me guess... You recognize the owner. You know who the boat belongs to... Is it your darling Theodore?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: "Theodore didn't leave by boat, he's still here..." Is that what made you hesitate?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Worried he'd be trapped here and die, and you couldn't bear it? Or did you think he came back to save you? Were you touched? Did you start believing he loves you again?
The words strike home, and Sallie has no comeback. Milly leans down and cups her face.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hahaha, oh, Sallie. You're so cute. All those lessons you preached to me... have you forgotten them all when it's your turn? Is love really so magical it can make even you lose your head? Well, then, let's take a little trip down memory lane.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: No... Don't...
Milly laughs and laughs, honey oozing from her fingertips. She dips it in Sallie's fear and smears it across her terrified face, as happy as a girl applying makeup to her best friend.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Think back... and don't forget what you told me... Love is the dumbest joke there is. True love and destiny are lies. Hormones, stories, every flutter of the heart... they're all lies.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: There's no such thing as perfect love. No one is coming to save you. And the one you love is never, ever to be trusted...
The woman's voice distorts, fading into the distance. Sallie's consciousness slips.

In her daze, through a break in the sandstorm, she sees a few boats trying desperately to pull away. The people on board... something glitters on them. Right... stage costumes. So not everyone was killed... some still managed to escape...

But as she thinks this, the storm surges. The white sand begins to churn, forming a massive whirlpool with the ship at its center. Black contamination spills from the vortex, slowly spreading, chasing the boats... pushing further...
At the end of their escape route, a twisted black barrier rises, blocking the way. She watches as the whirlpool pulls the boats back, dragging them toward this hopeless abyss. Sallie's vision blurs.
In the darkness, she sees Theodore. Shy, timid, frightened Theodore... Did he escape? Would he be foolish enough to come back for her? What they had... was it really love?
...I never expected perfect love from him. I never expected him to save me. Because from the very beginning, I knew... he was a coward.
He's an introverted man. He was dragged into the bar by his dandy friends, too scared to speak or move. He didn't fit in but didn't have the guts to say no.

He's an insecure man. When he asked her out, his hands shook so badly he could barely hold the flowers. He'd write pages of notes for what to say on their date. He was always too scared to clear up misunderstandings. And after blocking that bottle for her, he was so terrified he grabbed her hand and ran several blocks.

He's a powerless man. He couldn't put on airs, but was forced into high society. He tried to start his own business, but his family smashed his shop and dragged him back. He fell in love, but was terrified that their relationship would be found out and she'd be humiliated. He didn't want to inherit the family business and dirty his hands, but every attempt to rebel ended in failure, until he finally lost the will to fight.
Yes, she always knew he couldn't save her. He couldn't even save himself. So why would she still...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I've always been a coward. That's why I admire you, and respect you...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: You're the bravest, proudest person I've ever met. You never back down, never give in. You shine brighter than any of the wealthy and noble people I've known. Just watching you gives me the courage to face my own miserable life.

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I'm sorry, Sallie. I'm not the best partner, nor the richest, the strongest, or the one who understands you most. The things I try hard to give you might not amount to anything. But I want to do my best to make you happy, even if it's just to thank you...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: ...Thank you for coming into my life.
Tears fall down her face.
...Me too.

I never understood your weakness. What does a privileged boy have to worry about? What could you possibly see in me besides vanity and looks? Everyone else was walking over me, but you said you admired and respected me. Such a spoiled brat who didn't know anything... Stupid, dumb idiot...

I cursed everyone, but you were so dumb I couldn't even get mad at you. So pathetic I couldn't keep my guard up. You asked me to trust you. Well, when I was with you, for just a little while... I wanted to live an easier life. I wanted to try trusting someone.
Was that a lie, too? Or did I lose my head in anger and push you away myself? Why did you come here? Why couldn't you look at me? Oh... I should've stayed calm. What if I got it all wrong...?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly was right... No matter how awful things looked, I should have talked to you first...
In her delirium, that familiar figure appears again. Sallie reaches out a trembling hand, trying to touch the face of her beloved in the hallucination.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: For in this goddamned world... it was you who made me forget how to hate...
Her vision slowly clears. Theodore's face morphs into Milly's, smeared with blood.
Is it because Sallie's dying? Milly doesn't look so frightening anymore.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's not too late, you know.
She's wearing her usual, silly smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's not too late, Sallie. See what's in your heart, and you'll never lose.
Sallie tries to ask what she means, but doesn't get the chance. Gunshots crack the air, and then...
In the distance, bullets hit Theodore's boat. The fuel tank explodes in a pillar of flames, drawing the puppets' attention for a second.
In that instant, a figure bursts through the smoke and fire, charging toward them.
Aaaahhh! LET HER GO!!!
The sudden blow catches Milly on the temple. She's flung to the side, tumbling across the floor, and doesn't get up for a moment. But that surprise attack is the only effective hit he lands.

Two puppets quickly recover from the explosion and pounce at Theodore. The frail young man is forced to abandon his plan of grabbing Sallie and running. He turns around, wildly brandishing a rifle he'd snatched from some guard. The bullets bounce off the puppets like mosquitoes off a window pane.

He screams and lunges forward, ramming the rifle sideways against the inhuman monsters. Theodore's lost his mind. He can't even get the words out to tell Sallie to run; he just shrieks to steel himself, all blood drained from his face. After taking a dozen heavy blows, he's seized and hurled aside like a ragdoll.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Theodore?!
The sight jolts Sallie awake. She scrambles over to Theodore's side. Blood and foam are bubbling from his mouth.
The puppets have shattered his body, and terror has crushed his mind. In this hard-won reunion, he can't manage a coherent sentence. Only confused mumbles escape his lips.

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: Run... Sallie... run...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I'm sorry...
Sallie's throat tightens, and she pulls him protectively into her arms.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You idiot! If you're going to be a coward, be a coward all the way! Why play the hero now?! You—

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Stay back!

She snatches Theodore's rifle and points it at the approaching puppets. Hatred drives away her fear, consuming her, filling her with a strength she's never felt. She glares at the monsters she was running from just moments before.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I said, stay back! You bastards!!
She fires without hesitation. The puppets try to dodge, but strangely, they seem to be moving in slow motion in her eyes. Sallie adjusts her aim and fires again, blasting a hole in one puppet's head.
The vile thing stutters, then straightens its neck with both hands and attacks again. Sallie's out of bullets. She grabs the barrel and swings the rifle like a club.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Die, you monster—!

steps.speaker: Puppet
steps.content: SCREEEEEE!!!
Before the stock connects, the puppet's body convulses. Several slimy spikes burst from its torso. It shrieks and rolls away.
That, of course, isn't Sallie's doing. As the puppet collapses, she sees someone standing behind it. He's holding another monster by the neck and glowering at her with a grim expression.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...Is that how you use a gun?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Cassian?! You're alive!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: When did your power get so...
Wait, it's the same with her. The same gun, the same bullets. Useless when Theodore fired it, but in her hands, they actually did damage... What happened? Is this her power?
No... She feels something warm on her face. She wipes a hand across her cheek—it's honey. The black is fading away, turning into a brilliant gold.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: This isn't my power...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I was never this fast. Nor this strong. After you made me watch... that stuff, something's been wrong with me.
He says no more, his eyes fixed on the Sinner behind the puppet as she slowly pushes herself up.
Milly's temple is split, blood smearing her glove as she presses her hand against the wound. Theodore's hit has done serious damage.
Yet this witch, who just tormented everyone, is smiling. Cassian doesn't dare lower his guard, but he's genuinely perplexed.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...Was this your doing?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: What did you do to me? Where did this power come from? What exactly are you planning?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't be so mad. I'm sorry I didn't tell you. But the <color=#fb9259>Raincoat</color> was watching my every move. I'm a dumb girl, and this was the only way I could think of to help everyone. I'm so glad it worked!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You two are the last ones. I've given everyone the blessing of love. Now you're all stronger. You can make it out of here. Hurry, before the big monster wakes up.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: What are you talking about? You know that man won't let anyone escape. The sorcery has been activated. They're sealing off the ship. These B-Class Sinners can't possibly...
Milly doesn't answer. She turns her gaze to the others fleeing in the distance.
The honey she shared gave them strength, enough to fight off the puppets and strive for freedom. It rekindled their long-lost hope: to leave this place, to fight, to live.

Mr. E must have anticipated their little struggle. He would have prepared a backup plan. The sorcery at the ship's base is activating, the maelstrom of Mania expanding and pulling at everyone trying to escape like a bog. At Euphoria's end, the barrier of corruption is growing thicker, blocking the sky, mocking anyone who dares to hope.
Milly understands this, yet she shows no fear. She never seems to know what it means to be afraid.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: How will we know if we don't try? I've awakened the love in your hearts. You must believe that love can create miracles.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Why are you still saying these things? That alone won't—
Boom—

The impact sends ripples across the rising Mania barrier. On the other side, several patrol ships are pushing doggedly against the quicksand. On the deck of the lead vessel, a weak figure clutches the railing, fighting to stay on the front line.

The Mania is causing the contamination within him to roil out of control. The violent ash storm blocks his vision and jams the navigation systems. He strains his eyes but can barely see what lies ahead.
steps.female_content: The Mania is causing the contamination within her to roil out of control. The violent ash storm blocks her vision and jams the navigation systems. She strains her eyes but can barely see what lies ahead.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hehe... Just as I thought. That cruise ship was just a decoy. Their real hideout is here, buried deep.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How dare they use Mania contamination so brazenly... A desperate move after being exposed. Trying to destroy all evidence? Not a chance!
You close your eyes and concentrate. The contamination within you is boiling. Something massive out there is resonating with it, activating it. Endure, and then... catch it...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Found it!

options: Three o'clock! Breach that position! Fire!

steps.content: More impacts hit. Not strong enough to tear through the Mania barricade, but the ripples are a clear signal of hope, an affirmation from fate that their rebellion was not in vain.

The long-oppressed find their strength. Empowered by the golden blessing, they focus their attack on that single point of weakness in the barrier. Slowly but surely, they tear open a crack in Euphoria's darkness.
[Scene Change]
Sallie clutches the unconscious Theodore, tears welling in her eyes. At last, the weight of repression is lifted, and the world opens up before her. She turns eagerly to her friends.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: We're getting out of here, Cassian! Milly!
Milly is also gazing at the crack. Bathed in a soft golden light, she looks dazed, but deeply satisfied.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: See? When we have love in our hearts, when we fight for that love, miracles will happen.

A chill runs down Sallie's spine. The black filth on Milly's body has turned into golden honey, but beneath the sweet glaze, Sallie can see red patterns spreading across the Sinner's skin, clinging to her like veins... like some kind of parasitic vine.
Cassian recognizes it. His eyes widen in disbelief.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: It wasn't that man... Your power comes from the one behind him. The master of those puppets...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: What did you trade? Don't tell me—
A violent tremor cuts him off. From the belly of the ship, from the depths of the swirling vortex, comes a low, twisted growl.

Something has awakened. Mania contamination erupts from below, and nearby Corruptors and sand beasts shriek in response. The sandstorm intensifies, cutting off their paths. He can only hear Milly's soft reply through the honey.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I told you, a monster's about to wake up. If you don't go now, you'll be eaten before anyone can save you. I'm the only one who can stop it now. Leave it to me.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It looks like ${PlayerName} has a lot of enemies here. Please, help me get word to him. And don't die, okay? Everyone here is my friend.
steps.female_content: It looks like ${PlayerName} has a lot of enemies here. Please, help me get word to her. And don't die, okay? Everyone here is my friend.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't just stand there. The blessing of love has a time limit. Finally, there's a chance to get out of here alive. You have to seize it. Sometimes you only get one shot to change your fate.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If you really think of us as your little sisters, then at least save one of us. Don't make the same mistake again.
Cassian hesitates, watching the white sand flowing faster beneath his feet and the Mania pulsing from the ship's hull. Finally, he grits his teeth and makes up his mind.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...Damn it!
He grabs Sallie and the unconscious Theodore and jumps onto the boat. The vessel, built only for two, pitches and rolls, barely landing upright on the sand.
The key he gave Sallie is long gone. Cassian morphs his blood into a key, a shape he's known by heart. Without hesitation, he turns the key and starts the engine.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Cassian? What are you doing? What about Milly?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...If you want to help her, we need to get out of here and find someone who can. We can't do anything now. We'd only be a burden.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What do you mean? She's not coming with us? Milly!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly!
At the heart of the Mania contamination, the crimson vines are crawling over Milly's body, carving into her skin. The backlash is corrupting her flesh, but it can't take the smile from her face.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: What did you trade? Don't tell me—
On the other side, in a departing boat far from the battle, a man is holding a black umbrella, sheltering the weak Sage against the storm.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: What do you suppose she had to give me? Poor girl. No power, no money, no one to look after her. All alone, barely strong enough to protect herself. To make a deal with me, she could only offer her life.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: But I have a soft spot for her kind. As the bells toll for the end of the world, I find a special fondness for those who still choose to live with such innocence.
So wretched, yet so fortunate. So foolish, yet so prudent. Always clutching that fragile, unwavering passion... People like her are rare these days. It's a pity, Evelleon thinks.
From the wound she cut for Milly, blood begins to boil. Crimson patterns grow and spread, channeling the fiery life force from another into the Sage's ashen body.

steps.speaker: Evelleon
steps.content: You've taken more than enough of my power. Now, it's time to give me back your most fervent love. And death.
Sallie has never felt such panic. She struggles desperately, trying to break free from Cassian's grip, to jump from the boat, grab that idiot and scream some sense into her.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You dummy! Are you playing hero for your Chief?!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: That's right! I just love him that much. What can I say? I'm an idiot.
steps.female_content: That's right! I just love her that much. What can I say? I'm an idiot.

steps.content: Yet there she is, with that same, infuriatingly stubborn smile. Even with her body covered in scars and corruption, she is still smiling like a silly sun in the dark night.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Stop lecturing me already. I won't listen anyway! Let's just make up while we can.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: That was the first time I've fought with a friend. I'm not good with words, so I couldn't argue back yesterday. But the more I thought about it, the madder I got, so I couldn't help messing with you just now. I was just trying to scare you. Don't be mad at me, okay?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: When we get out of here, let's meet up and tell each other our little secrets about love.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not going to die. I still need to see the one I love!
In an instant, the Mania surges, and the storm swallows Euphoria whole.
